chapters.title: Resolve the config
chapters.text: Maester merges your config files into one: what to run, settings for each check, and where results go.

chapters.title: Select the checks
chapters.text: Your selection picks checks by product, framework, severity, test ID or pack. -DryRun shows the list before anything runs.

chapters.title: Apply the gates
chapters.text: A check that needs a service you didn't connect, or a licence you don't have, is skipped with a reason code. It is never marked failed.

chapters.title: Run on the engine
chapters.text: The engine runs each planned check, enforces time-outs and turns a family into one row per policy, mailbox or app.

chapters.title: Write the report
chapters.text: One result becomes the HTML report, JSON, JUnit for your pipeline, and email or Teams alerts.

chapters.title: The gates
chapters.text: Before a check runs, it passes through gates, in this order. A check that stops at a gate is skipped, with that gate's reason code.

chapters.title: Stopped at a gate
chapters.text: This Teams check reaches the service gate. Teams isn't connected, so it stops there: Skipped, ServiceNotConnected. Not failed.

chapters.title: Through every gate
chapters.text: This check passes every gate, so the engine runs it. The report lists every skipped check with its reason, so you know what to fix.

chapters.title: Maester
chapters.text: This is Maester: the open-source way to test your Microsoft 365 security, every day, in one run.
chapters.say: This is Mayster: the open-source way to test your Microsoft three sixty-five security, every day, in one run.

chapters.title: Install
chapters.text: Install it from the PowerShell Gallery. Every check ships inside the module, so there's nothing else to set up.

chapters.title: Connect
chapters.text: Connect Maester to your tenant. It reads your configuration with read-only permissions, and nothing leaves your tenant.
chapters.say: Connect Mayster to your tenant. It reads your configuration with read-only permissions, and nothing leaves your tenant.

chapters.title: Run
chapters.text: Now run Invoke-Maester. Add the Zero Trust Assessment pack, and Microsoft's own assessment runs in the same pass.
chapters.say: Now run Invoke Mayster. Add the Zero Trust Assessment pack, and Microsoft's own assessment runs in the same pass.

chapters.title: Watch it run
chapters.text: The console shows every product as it's tested, the checks running right now, and the results as they land: over twelve hundred checks across CIS, CISA, Microsoft's guidance and Zero Trust.
chapters.say: The console shows every product as it's tested, the checks running right now, and the results as they land: over twelve hundred checks across C.I.S., Sissa, Microsoft's guidance and Zero Trust.

chapters.title: The report
chapters.text: When the run finishes, your report opens. It tells you what to fix first, ranked by severity and effort.

chapters.title: Every finding
chapters.text: Every finding explains what an attacker could do, what Maester found, and exactly how to fix it.
chapters.say: Every finding explains what an attacker could do, what Mayster found, and exactly how to fix it.

chapters.title: Frameworks
chapters.text: See where you stand against the frameworks your auditors ask about, and the attack techniques each gap leaves open.

chapters.title: Zero Trust
chapters.text: And Microsoft's Zero Trust Assessment sits right alongside, in the same report.

chapters.title: Automate
chapters.text: Run it every day in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, and know the moment something changes.

chapters.title: Maester Cloud
chapters.text: Or run it with Maester Cloud, securely, in your own Azure subscription: your data never leaves your tenant. Find out more at maester.cloud, and get started at maester.dev.
chapters.say: Or run it with Mayster Cloud, securely, in your own Azure subscription: your data never leaves your tenant. Find out more at mayster dot cloud, and get started at mayster dot dev.
